title: Chronic exposure to environmentally relevant benzophenones induces male reproductive dysfunction via ER-mediated disulfidptosis: therapeutic potential of zeaxanthin dipalmitate.
authors: Li, Hong-Mei; Kou, Ju-Qin; Pu, Ya-Jia; Wang, Qian; Sheng, Yu-Xin; Wang, Jun-Ze; Tian, Ya-Nan; Gao, Yan-Rong; Sun, Jia-He; Zeng, Xiao-Qi; Xu, Hai-Ming
one_liner_zh: 该文研究二苯甲酮暴露经ER介导的二硫下垂导致雄性生殖毒性，属毒理学与内分泌干扰机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟建模内容，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Benzophenones (BPs), widely used UV filters and endocrine disruptors globally known for their estrogenic effects, are raising growing concerns about chronic reproductive toxicity in males due to their increasing environmental concentrations. This study aims to reveal the effects and mechanisms of male reproductive injury induced by environmentally relevant concentrations of BPs exposure. METHODS: The study employed NHANES analysis, animal experiments, cell experiments, network toxicology, and molecular docking, and used transcriptome sequencing along with various biochemical and molecular experimental methods to measure downstream indicators. RESULTS: Analysis of the NHANES database indicates that BP-3 exposure showed dose-dependent associations with reduced total testosterone (TT)/estradiol (E2)/sex hormone-binding globulin (SHBG) and elevated testosterone deficiency (TD) risk. Effects attenuated but held direction after multi-pollutant adjustment. The results of animal experiments indicate that chronic exposure to BPs (PND1-PND240) impaired fertility and offspring development, reduced body weight, anogenital distance, and testis coefficient, and altered histopathology, sperm quantity, and quality. Differentially expressed genes were predominantly enriched in energy metabolism and integrity of actin cytoskeleton, and disulfidptosis-related metabolic/redox indicators were dysregulated in the testis. Notably, even short-term exposure to BP-3 disturbs the levels of disulfidptosis-associated metabolic drivers (PND1-PND56). In GC-2 cells, BP-3 reduced cell viability and antioxidant capacity, induced morphological alterations, elevated ROS level, and upregulated disulfidptosis markers. The involvement of disulfidptosis was confirmed by the addition of the antagonist TCEP and agonist KL-11743. Notably, estrogen receptor (ER) directly regulates disulfidptosis. Zeaxanthin dipalmitate (ZD) alleviates BPs-induced male reproductive injury by modulating disulfidptosis. Co-culture assays further confirmed BP-3 disrupts testicular metabolic coupling and triggers disulfidptosis. CONCLUSION: BPs exposure induces male reproductive dysfunction via ER-mediated disulfidptosis. ZD can alleviate this dysfunction.
abstract_zh: 背景：二苯甲酮类化合物（BPs）作为广泛使用的紫外线吸收剂和环境内分泌干扰物，因其雌激素效应而全球闻名，且随着其在环境中浓度不断升高，其对男性慢性生殖毒性的担忧日益增加。本研究旨在揭示环境相关浓度BPs暴露所致男性生殖损伤的效应及机制。方法：本研究采用NHANES分析、动物实验、细胞实验、网络毒理学和分子对接，并利用转录组测序及多种生物化学和分子实验方法测定下游指标。结果：NHANES数据库分析表明，BP-3暴露与总睾酮（TT）/雌二醇（E2）/性激素结合球蛋白（SHBG）降低及睾酮缺乏（TD）风险升高呈剂量依赖性关联。在多污染物调整后，效应减弱但方向保持一致。动物实验结果表明，慢性BPs暴露（PND1-PND240）损害生育能力和后代发育，降低体重、肛门生殖器距离和睾丸系数，并改变组织病理学、精子数量和精子质量。差异表达基因主要富集于能量代谢和肌动蛋白细胞骨架完整性，且与二硫化物凋亡（disulfidptosis）相关的代谢/氧化还原指标在睾丸中发生失调。值得注意的是，即使短期暴露于BP-3也会扰乱二硫化物凋亡相关代谢驱动因子的水平（PND1-PND56）。在GC-2细胞中，BP-3降低细胞活力和抗氧化能力，诱导形态改变，升高ROS水平，并上调二硫化物凋亡标志物。通过添加拮抗剂TCEP和激动剂KL-11743确认了二硫化物凋亡的参与。值得注意的是，雌激素受体（ER）直接调控二硫化物凋亡。玉米黄质二棕榈酸酯（ZD）通过调节二硫化物凋亡缓解BPs诱导的雄性生殖损伤。共培养实验进一步证实BP-3破坏睾丸代谢耦合并触发二硫化物凋亡。结论：BPs暴露通过ER介导的二硫化物凋亡诱导雄性生殖功能障碍。ZD可缓解此功能障碍。
